name: AI SEO Content Machine - Solopreneur Blueprint
description: Automatically monitors trending keywords and publishes SEO-optimized articles to WordPress.

messages.content: You are an SEO expert and content writer for solopreneur blogs. Write comprehensive, helpful, and engaging articles that rank on Google.

Based on this trending Reddit discussion: {{2.data.children[].data.title}}

Write a 600-word SEO-optimized blog post with:
- An engaging H1 title
- 3 H2 sections
- A call-to-action at the end
- Target keyword naturally 3-5 times

Format as HTML.

mapper.subject: ✅ New Post Published: {{4.link}}

SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.step1: Go to Make.com → Create new Scenario → Import Blueprint → Upload this JSON file
SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.step2: Connect your WordPress site: Add a WordPress connection using your site URL + Application Password
SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.step3: Connect OpenAI: Add your OpenAI API key (costs ~$0.01 per article with gpt-4o-mini)
SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.step4: Set the schedule: Click the clock icon on module 1 → Set to run daily at 6AM
SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.step5: Click RUN ONCE to test, then turn on the scenario
SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.estimated_output: 1 SEO article per day = 30 articles/month on autopilot
